podcast.body: An alternate, demo version of this song was legitimately released as a B-side on the seven-inch single of the official version. This vinyl record was exclusively sold in the UK and its inclusion enhanced the single's collectibility due to the scarcity and exclusivity of seven-inch singles in England. "Billy Talents, they authorize the use of that demo version on the B side of Devil in a Midnight Mass to enhance that seven inch singles collectibility."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was the first single released from their second album, "Billy Talent 2." "Devil and a midnight mass, the first single from that second album, cleverly entitled, Billy Talent 2."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
